title: docs(adr-0067): stale rollback claims follow the code: the in-memory driver rolls back, and revert runs per item
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XYWs8KnjCjmeMQYz1x8dWx8)_

Fixes #32504

domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5n1GK9KeZD8fhHUf49

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:五处代码注释不再说「内存驱动不能回滚」(它用整库快照实现了 `beginTransaction` / `rollback`);ADR-0067 新增 2026-11-14 修订节,写明 `revertCommit` 是逐项回退、返回 `reverted[]` / `failed[]`,`rollbackToPackageCommit` 是逐个 commit 调 `revertCommit`,两者都不开跨项事务;注册表同步等写后故障不进 `failed[]`;回退一个回退 commit 目前什么也恢复不了(列为待定)。原句保留,就地加注指向修订节。
- 为什么改:文字与 `main` 上的代码相反:读注释的人会以为内存驱动上的测试没测到回滚;读 ADR 的人会以为一次失败的回退不会留下「回退了一半」的包。
- 风险与回滚:只改注释与一个 ADR 文件,不改任何行为;因注释随 `.d.ts` 发布,带一个三包 patch changeset;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`docs/adr/0067-commit-history-and-rollback-for-ai-authoring.md` 文末「Amendment (2026-11-14, #32504)」节,重点是「What this amendment does not decide」:是否把回退改成原子仍待你定,本 PR 不做。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat`,预期 6 个文件(含一个 changeset);`git grep -n "in-memory driver in tests\|against in-memory drivers" packages/` 无命中。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`docs/adr/**`):请批准或合并。

## What changes

**Item 1 — the in-memory driver rolls back (comments only).** `packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-driver.ts` implements `beginTransaction` (copies every table and record into a snapshot) and `rollback` (restores it), and declares no `transactionsUnsupported`, so `driverSupportsTransactions` and `engineCanRollBack` answer yes for it. Five docblocks said otherwise:

- `packages/spec/src/data/driver.zod.ts`, `driverSupportsTransactions` clause 1: the in-memory driver is no longer listed among drivers with no `beginTransaction`; the clause says it implements one over a snapshot.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts`, `SysMetadataEngine.transaction` docblock: "must not rely on rollback … against in-memory drivers" becomes "where the engine cannot roll back (`engineCanRollBack` answers no …)".
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts`, `withTxn` docblock (same file, same defect class, the docblock the card names): drops "in-memory drivers … get no rollback, which is acceptable because production always runs on a SQL driver with real ACID" — both halves are false on `main` (the in-memory driver rolls back; remote Turso is SQL without rollback, per the ADR-0067 2026-11-12 amendment).
- `packages/spec/src/contracts/objectql-engine.ts`, `EngineTransactionOptions.require` docblock: the callers the no-transaction degrade suits are test doubles; "in-memory drivers" is dropped from that parenthesis (the driver implements `beginTransaction`).
- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, `ObjectQL.transaction` docblock: the no-rollback examples become a test double, remote Turso and OData; the in-memory driver runs the callback inside a transaction.
- The three docblocks that now say the in-memory driver rolls back (`SysMetadataEngine.transaction`, `withTxn`, `ObjectQL.transaction`) carry the caveat the ADR-0067 2026-11-12 amendment records: the rollback restores the whole store to its state at begin, with no isolation, and also discards what other callers wrote since that begin (unsafe with concurrent writers). `driver-memory` is reachable outside tests (`os serve`'s storage driver), so the repository docblock must not read as permission to rely on it.

**Item 2 — ADR-0067 D3 (`docs/adr/0067-commit-history-and-rollback-for-ai-authoring.md`).** No ruled sentence is deleted or rewritten:

- Status line: a new `· **Amended** (2026-11-14, #32504 — …)` entry, in the form of the two before it.
- TL;DR 3 and both D3 bullets (`revertCommit`, `rollbackToPackageCommit`): an italic `*(Amended 2026-11-14: … — see the Amendment of that date at the end.)*` marker appended in place, the form D2's caveat and the Costs line already use for the 2026-11-12 amendment.
- New section `## Amendment (2026-11-14, #32504)`: what the two doors do on `main`: a per-item walk in reverse apply order; each item's row and history write in the repository's per-item `withTxn`; no transaction across items; an item refused, or whose removal or restore throws, goes into `failed[]` and the walk continues; a fault after the row write (registry write-through or heal, the projector, storage sync) does not reach `failed[]` and the item stays in `reverted[]` (one exception: an `object_extension` heal's store-read fault is rethrown); an item with no `prevVersion` is skipped, in neither list, which is every item a revert commit restored, so reverting a revert commit restores nothing today; the revert commit written from `reverted[]` and best effort (`recordPackageCommit` catches every error and returns no record; the revert then answers without `revertCommitId` and is on no package-commit timeline); `success` only when `failed[]` is empty and something was reverted. Then the partly-reverted shape, and what the amendment does not decide: whether revert should become atomic; whether a revert commit should carry the versions it restored, and whether post-write faults should reach `failed[]` (both code questions); Decision-2 and the publish door unchanged.

The `rollbackToPackageCommit` bullet ("as one transaction") is the same stale claim one line below the card's sentence, and TL;DR 3 names both doors, so both are marked (os-dev bounded in-place fix: same defect class, same file, mechanical, same gate families).

## Acceptance notes

Every claim was read from the code on `origin/main` at `ba35dfd7`:

| Claim | Read from |
|---|---|
| in-memory `beginTransaction` / `rollback` over a snapshot; no `transactionsUnsupported` | `packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-driver.ts` (`readonly supports = {}`, `beginTransaction`, `rollback`) |
| remote Turso and OData declare no rollback | `packages/drivers/driver-turso/src/turso-driver.ts` (`transactionsUnsupported: this.transportMode === 'remote'`), `packages/drivers/driver-odata/src/odata-driver.ts` |
| `revertCommit` opens no transaction | `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-commits.ts`: zero `transaction` / `withTxn` hits in the file |
| per-item walk in reverse apply order; per-item `try`/`catch` into `failed[]`; commit from `reverted[]`; `success` | `ProtocolPackageCommitsFacet.revertCommit` (`for (const it of [...items].reverse())`, `catch (e)` pushing `failed`, `recordPackageCommit({ items: reverted.map(…) })`, `success: failed.length === 0 && reverted.length > 0`) |
| per-item write in `withTxn` | `SysMetadataRepository.restoreVersion` returns `this.put(…)`; `put` and `delete` run in `this.withTxn` |
| a fault after the row write does not reach `failed[]` | restore limb: `applyRegistryWriteThrough` (`protocol-registry-hydration.ts`) catches and warns, its result is not read; `runMutationProjector` (`protocol-mutation-fan-out.ts`) catches and returns `{ success: false }`, not read; `ensureObjectStorage`'s refusal goes on `advisories`. Soft-remove limb: `restoreArtifactRegistryView`'s outer `catch` logs ("the delete has committed and is not failed here"); its `object_extension` branch calls `resyncStoredObjectExtensions` before that `try`, which rethrows a store-read fault other than an unprovisioned table |
| an item with no `prevVersion` is skipped | `restoreToVersion` is `null` unless `existedBefore` and a `prevVersion`; the walk has `if (!it.existedBefore)` and `else if (restoreToVersion !== null)` and no other branch. A revert commit's plan is `existedBefore: r.action === 'restored', prevVersion: null`; `readRevertableCommit` does not refuse a `revert` commit |
| rollback = one `revertCommit` per commit; failures collected, none stops it | `ProtocolPackageCommitsFacet.rollbackToPackageCommit` (`for (const c of toRevert)`, `step.failed` folded, `catch` folded) |
| revert commit record is best effort | `protocol-package-commit-record.ts` `recordPackageCommit` (`catch`: unprovisioned table logs once at `info`, any other failure logs at `error`, both `return null`); `revertCommit` spreads `revertCommitId` only when a record came back |
| in-memory rollback is store-wide, no isolation | `memory-driver.ts` `rollback` assigns `this.db = tx.snapshot`, the snapshot taken at that transaction's `beginTransaction` |
| pinned | `protocol.revert-stored-type-canonical.test.ts` "reverts the neighbours of a refused item and reports the mix honestly" |

- #32480 (ADR-0067 D2 amendment) has landed; this text sits after it and does not touch it. Its "makes no statement about Decision-3's revert doors" line is the gap this amendment fills.
- No other in-repo text repeats the stale claims: `git grep -i -C2 "in-memory"` over non-test `packages/**/*.ts`, filtered for `atomic|transaction|rollback|ACID`, leaves only registry-mutation comments (not drivers) and the driver's own snapshot docblock, now that `objectql-engine.ts` is fixed (round 1's grep missed it: a one-line pattern did not reach `atomicity` on the line before; `content/docs/releases/` is release-owned and not touched). ADR-0067 D2's original caveat (L79) was already marked by #32480.
- Not decided here: making `revertCommit` / `rollbackToPackageCommit` atomic (a behaviour change: a revert with one refused item would revert nothing). The amendment names it as open.
- Changeset: `.changeset/32504-in-memory-rollback-docblocks.md`, `patch` for `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (TSDoc only; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`). The edited docblocks land in shipped `dist/*.d.ts`, and spec ships `src/**/*.zod.ts` itself (contract review 6884842817 ②). The `skip-changeset` label is the seat's to remove.
- Round 2 (contract review 6884842817): ② changeset added; ④ the amendment now says the revert commit record is best effort and no longer says every returned rollback step "has recorded" its revert commit; ④ the in-memory caveat added to three docblocks; nit "reverted work" reads "rolled-back work". Outside this diff: `protocol.ts`'s `rollbackToPackageCommit` docblock ("records its revert commit") has the same best-effort gap; named in the report for a follow-up (filed as #33486).
- Round 3 (at-tier contract review 6886701800, FAIL on 75c02290): M1 the amendment no longer says a fault after the row write reaches `failed[]`; it says what the code does (and the acceptance row above is corrected; round 1's row was wrong). S1 the skipped outcome is named, "cannot itself be reverted" now claims only the missing commit row, and D3's "itself revertible" is listed under "does not decide"; the D3 `revertCommit` marker adds "reverting a revert commit restores nothing today". S2 `objectql-engine.ts` fixed in place, changeset prose extended. Nits: "reverse apply order", "no package-commit timeline", and in `engine.ts` the rollback is now the subject of "restores". Beyond the review: the `object_extension` heal exception, read from `resyncStoredObjectExtensions`. The amendment heading now reads "reports per item" (it said "names what it could not do", which the post-write and skipped outcomes make untrue).
- Tier: `dispatch-gates --tier` reads the MANDATORY contract-review tier for `docs/adr/**`; this card thread ran at the claim's default model. The seat's in-seat contract review is the owed record (named deviation).
- Governed: `check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/project-thread-0ky6fu` — GOVERNED, 1 of 4 paths (`docs/adr/**`), landing tier H; 99 changed lines, under the 3000 threshold.
